# Video Brochure Plus

> Video Brochure Plus is the customer-facing website of Wuhan Superlieur Technology Co., Ltd. for custom LCD video-in-print projects.

## Canonical website
- https://www.videobrochureplus.com/

## Products
- https://www.videobrochureplus.com/video-brochure — Custom video brochures; current standard MOQ from 10 pieces; 4.3 to 10.1 inch planning range.
- https://www.videobrochureplus.com/video-mailers — Video brochures with protective delivery packaging for direct-mail projects.
- https://www.videobrochureplus.com/video-box — Rigid video presentation boxes; current standard MOQ from 50 pieces.
- https://www.videobrochureplus.com/video-greeting-card — Video greeting cards; 2.4 to 5 inch planning range; current standard MOQ from 50 pieces.
- https://www.videobrochureplus.com/video-business-cards — Compact 2.4-inch video business cards; current standard MOQ from 100 pieces.
- https://www.videobrochureplus.com/video-folders — A4/A5 video folders with 7 or 10.1 inch screens; current standard MOQ from 30 pieces.
- https://www.videobrochureplus.com/video-wedding-invitations — Video invitations with 4.3 or 5 inch screens; current standard MOQ from 20 pieces.
